title: Really Bad Pinball
subtitle: 2D | Action Platformer | Level Control
content: 2D Action Platformer made using Unity and C#
summary: Designed levels and polish for a physics prototype where players rotate the level instead of the ball.
description: Really Bad Pinball is an eccentric game where players manipulate the level itself to guide the ball. Developed as a prototype over a period of two weeks, the game challenges players to control the level to navigate through obstacles, gather coins, and unlock gates.
roles: Designed and developed the concept of the game
Designed and structured the levels in the game using the game engine
Scripted core mechanics of the game
Implemented lighting and VFX to give the game a more polished look
details: This was a team assignment for our Gameplay Prototyping course at RIT. Developed over a weekend, the prototype explored a mechanic where players control the level instead of directly controlling the ball. Players rotate the level to guide the ball through obstacles, collect coins, and unlock gates. I designed and structured levels using modular assets, then supported lighting, VFX, and general polish for the playable demo.
